name: Diana Seabeck
occupation: Speech-language pathologist, Albany County School District 1
education: B.A., University of Arizona; M.S. in speech-language pathology, University of Wyoming
background: Diana Seabeck of Laramie ran as a Republican for Senate District 9 in 2022. In her 2022 voter-guide statement she said she grew up in several states, moved to Wyoming in 1973, had been married to her husband, Robert, for 48 years, and that they raised two sons in Laramie and had five grandchildren. She wrote that she earned a B.A. at the University of Arizona and an M.S. in speech-language pathology at the University of Wyoming, and that she worked 35 years for Albany County School District 1.

In the same statement she said that besides her work as a speech-language pathologist — including with middle-school students and students on the autism spectrum — she later served as a special-education case manager, as Drug-Free Schools coordinator (including co-writing a $3 million grant, supervising employees, and overseeing multiple budgets), and as coordinator for a Safe Schools, Healthy Students initiative.
